source: happens. For example, a table converted into a flat stream may separate a value from its row and column labels; retrieval may later return the correct-looking number with the wrong meaning. UDA was designed around raw PDFs/HTML and specifically highlights parsing as an end-to-end ZXNAME0000XZ bottleneck. Production systems should evaluate extraction on representative document types, preserve source coordinates and structural metadata where useful, and treat tables or layout-heavy material with parsers or multimodal methods appropriate to the source. Better embeddings cannot recover information that parsing destroyed. [3]
